title: demo.json
description: The keynote cut: title cards and scenes in story order. Read by build-keynote.py, keynote-handoff.py, narrate.py and rec.mjs. Every look value defaults to docs/quality-bar.md.

title.description: Product name, short. Also names the output file.

logo.description: Logo path relative to demo.json (PNG or SVG). Empty for none.

browser.description: Recording context options for rec.mjs (mk-setup.sh reads DEMO_TIMEZONE and DEMO_LOCALE instead).

windows.description: Named Chrome windows for multi-window recording with rec.mjs and run.mjs.

voice.description: Narration for narrate.py. Every field is optional.

provider.description: say (macOS, free), elevenlabs (needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in the environment, or a macOS Keychain item named by ELEVENLABS_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE or elevenlabs.keychain_service) or files (ready-made voiceover/NN.mp3|wav|m4a: your own recordings, or files made with an MCP voice tool from narrate.py --export-lines). Default: files when voiceover/ has them, else elevenlabs when a key is found, else say.

rate_wpm.description: Words per minute for say and for estimates. Default 165.

say_voice.description: macOS say voice, for example Samantha. Default: system voice.

voice_id.description: ElevenLabs voice id. Default: a stock premade voice.

keychain_service.description: macOS Keychain service name holding the ElevenLabs key; must start with elevenlabs. Read with `security find-generic-password -s <name> -w` only when ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is unset and you ran narrate.py with --voice elevenlabs. The env var ELEVENLABS_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE wins over this. Holds a name, never the key.

lead_in.description: Seconds into an item before its line starts. Default 0.3.

music.description: Music bed path relative to demo.json. Looped, ducked under speech.

music_volume.description: Fixed bed level before ducking (0 to 1). Leave it out: narrate.py sets the bed music_gap_db under the narration.

music_fade_in.description: Seconds the music fades in at the start. Default 0 (no fade).

music_fade_out.description: Seconds the music fades out at the end. Default 1.5, or 4.0 before a silent outro.

music_gap_db.description: dB the bed sits under the narration between lines. Default 13 (bar: 12 to 14).

music_dips.description: Deliberate drops of the bed (about -9 dB) under key moments (A6).

match.description: URL part of the tab to drive. Defaults to the first tab.

rx_port.description: Frame receiver port for this window, so two windows can record at once.

duration.description: Seconds on screen. Defaults: hero 3.0, section 2.4, end 7.9.

kind.description: hero: title, settle, subtitle (default when there is a subtitle). section: one title (default otherwise). end: logo, title and tagline timed to its voiceover, then the brand sweep and logo outro (default for the last item).

accent.description: The one word of title shown in the accent colour (T9).

subtitle_accent.description: The one word of subtitle shown in the accent colour.

outro.description: End card only: seconds of brand sweep and logo outro after it. Default 5.0; 0 for none.

caption.description: Old form: becomes a statement pill at the start of the scene. Prefer callouts.

trim.description: [in, out] seconds of the raw take; null keeps that end.

zoom.description: Old form [factor, x, y, start, seconds]; becomes one 1.15x whole-window zoom. Prefer zooms.

crop.description: [x, y, w, h] in source px (the 1920x1080 take) around the UI that matters. Widened to the window's 1.95:1 shape. App body text should end up >= 18 px cap height: w <= 1560 x (cap px in the take) / 18.

zooms.description: Whole-window zooms (1.15x, 1.1 s ease-in-out sine in and out).

callouts.description: Pills under the window, one at a time, 3 to 5 s each.

highlights.description: Red outline boxes on one UI element, after a zoom lands.

imagePath.description: Image path relative to demo.json (.png, .jpg, .webp or .svg); must stay inside the demo folder.

brand.description: Look of the cut. Every field is optional; defaults are the quality bar's.

font.description: Bundled family for every rendered word (assets/fonts). Default inter (titles in Inter Display).

accent.description: The one accent word per title, and statement pills. Default #D9463B.

fields.description: Five soft colour fields: glow top left, blue top right, pink bottom right, grey bottom left, centre.

dark.description: Outro field behind the logo lockup. Default #1B1D21.

logo_on_dark.description: Logo variant for the dark outro (a light mark). Default: logo.

at.description: Seconds into the scene (after trim and speed) when the zoom-in starts.

focus.description: [x, y] in source px: what the zoom points at. The window moves up to 70 px toward it.

dur.description: Seconds held at full zoom before easing back. Default 3.0; the bar wants 2.4 to 4.5.

at.description: Seconds into the scene when the pill enters.

dur.description: Seconds on screen before the exit. Default 4; the bar wants 3 to 5.

kind.description: statement (default): accent text, at most 6 words. person: avatar + "Name," + role.

text.description: The statement, or the person's name.

role.description: Person pills: the role, shown in grey after the name.

avatar.description: Person pills: a square photo, shown as a 50 px circle.

at.description: Seconds into the scene. Leave it out to show 0.17 s after the next zoom lands (H5).

dur.description: Seconds before it fades. Default: until its zoom has eased back.

rect.description: [x, y, w, h] of the element's text box in source px (from the record step's scout: CSS box x 4/3 at DPR 2 -> 1080p).
